nodes.label: Workflow: Sincronizar el Space de Hugging Face
nodes.norm_label: workflow: sincronizar el space de hugging face
nodes.rationale: HF Space is a separate git repo with a different layout, so this is an assembly, not a mirror. Clones with GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 to avoid downloading 638 MB datos_linux.zip; never touches datos_linux.zip or results/ because GitHub repo cannot restore them (.gitignored). Guards against wfdb/h5py in requirements after the 17 Sep 2026 503 outage. Waits for rebuild in 3 phases so it does not validate the old container.

nodes.label: HF Space requirements.txt (no wfdb/h5py)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately omits wfdb and h5py: Dockerfile installs them in a separate step and re-pins numpy==1.24.3, since wfdb 4.3.1 needs numpy>=1.26.4 and pip would fail with ResolutionImpossible.

nodes.label: GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 clone
nodes.rationale: Fetches 133-byte LFS pointer instead of 638 MB; otherwise each sync would download and re-upload the file.

nodes.label: 17 Sep 2026 503 outage (numpy/wfdb ResolutionImpossible)
nodes.rationale: Project requirements.txt (with wfdb) was copied into the Space; wfdb 4.3.1 requires numpy>=1.26.4 while model was saved with numpy 1.24.3.

nodes.label: CNN_GRU_ATTN final model

nodes.label: Workflow: Mantener el servicio despierto
nodes.rationale: HF free-tier Spaces sleep after ~48h idle; cold start (TensorFlow + model load) exceeds the UI's 15 s timeout and looks like an error. Pings every 6 h at minute 17: tolerates 7 missed runs, avoids top-of-hour load, costs ~122 of 2000 free minutes/month. Also the only automatic monitoring: fails (emailing owner) if not healthy, no model loaded, or patients != 123.
